name: archspec-playground
description: archspec in the browser: a catalog of models, a live YAML editor, the model checker, and the archspec-viz visualization — all client-side via WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg --out-name archspec
scripts.build:wasm: npm run wasm && wasm-opt -Os --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue -o wasm/pkg/archspec_bg.wasm wasm/pkg/archspec_bg.wasm
